The following events took place in '''14 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Syal Antilles Fel|Syal Antilles]] ran away from home and changed her name to Wynssa Starflare.<ref name="Masquerade">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: Masquerade]]''</ref>
*[[Herd Meet/Legends|Herd Meet]] on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="Children of the Jedi (novel)">Date of the [[Herd Meet/Legends|Herd Meet]] is based on [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]]&mdash;who was born in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]&mdash; comment in [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] that she was "''five, maybe six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old''" when she had went to the meeting.</ref>
*[[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] entered the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Making a Full Recovery">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20021003recovery|text=Making a Full ''Recovery''}}</ref>
*The Empire disbanded [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]] and arrested [[Lens Reekeene|Lens]].<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>
